description: Hello everyone and welcome! It's been a whirlwind week, but thankfully, I have had a few minutes of downtime here and there. Here's this weeks list: • ActBlue - I have to admit to all that I have always had an "issue" with donating to politics, and ActBlue is no exception. So, gritting my teeth, I have applied for a fundraising account with them. What I have learned is that even though they do take a small cut, ActBlue is an excellent fundraising site.
